ideas.pitch: A community-driven grant allocation platform using quadratic funding to distribute local civic improvement funds.
ideas.title: LocalImpact Hyattsville
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since there are no specific sponsor tracks, judges will look for high civic utility and tangible local application that can be demoed live in Maryland.

ideas.pitch: Real-time micro-transit and pedestrian congestion monitor utilizing public data feeds and lightweight spatial heatmaps.
ideas.title: Hyattsville Mobility Pulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of localized utility and spatial data analysis, similar to GeoNex-ATLAS, which appeals strongly to regional hackathon judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student sustainability audit assistant that parses university utility data and recommends carbon-reduction steps.
ideas.title: CampusGreen Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the multi-agent orchestration pattern of Greennovation AI, delivering structured, actionable institutional insights within a tight timeframe.

ideas.pitch: An AI nutrition planner specifically localized to affordable grocery options and farmers markets available in the DC-Maryland-Virginia area.
ideas.title: NutriLocal DMV
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on the proven consumer-wellness hackathon winner formula by adding strong local hyper-relevance to differentiate from generic health apps.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight transaction anomaly detector designed for local non-profit treasuries to automatically flag suspicious fund movements.
ideas.title: CivicTrust AML Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts sophisticated financial compliance graph and risk-scoring techniques into an accessible tool for everyday organizations.
